decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Further details must be submitted regarding illumination of the site during construction prior to commencement of teh development of Ferry Wharf and works abutting the Thames.
Condition : 2 - Skips removing debris off the site should be covered to prevent accidental spillage.
description: Following approval for additions and alterations to the approved scheme (planning reference 00443/G/P4) for ' demolition of existing buildings and erection of 191 flats, 93 bed hotel (including ancillary restaurant), retail and restaurant units, Thameside path, vehicular access from Goat Whaf, change of use of Peerless Pump building to a restaurant and managers flat, underground car parking and landscaping' by the addition of 42 flats and an additional access from Town Meadow and widening of the inter-tidal inlet. Details submitted pursuant to (d) Condition 11 (site setup)
